probe: W0-SyncCeiling — SUPERSEDENCE RECORD, not a probe
status: GATE REOPENED — W0-SyncCeiling is NOT closed on the corpus worst case
WHAT_THIS_RECORD_IS_FOR: Two artifacts in this directory assert that dvcEDToK is 'the LONGEST call in
the corpus'. It is not. dvcEDToK is 204.3 min and ranks 47th of 229 by
duration. The real worst case is wiUyTRZb at 275.9 min / 16,556 s.
This file exists so that neither artifact can be read as truth again, and
so that a number which entered the evidence pack through a field-join error
is on the record as such.

the_defect: 275.9 min is wiUyTRZb's duration. 1,614,043,424 bytes is dvcEDToK's size.
Two units were joined into one string. The PASS artifact repeats the same
error in its cost block: '275.9-min unit, 204.3 min actually transcribed'.
Confirmation from the repo's own bytes: the uploaded .mka was 294,302,207 B
against a measured 12,258.603 s, which is 192.1 kbps — a standard AAC-LC
rate — and implies an audio ES of 294,206,472 B, matching the upload to
0.03%. At the 275.9 min figure the implied rate is 142.2 kbps, which is not
a standard rate. 204.31 min is correct for this unit; 275.9 min is not.

THE_SECOND_ORDER_DEFECT.summary: A fix propagated the unevidenced figures into the specification.
detail: Round 3 finding F1 correctly identified that dvcEDToK is not the worst case.
The fix then asserted that the REAL worst case, wiUyTRZb, had been measured
at 275.9 min, 156.2 s of server time, a 3.8x margin, 51,787 words, and
NONE of 156.2, 51787, 16556 or wiUyTRZb appears in ANY artifact in this
directory. Verified by grep across all 40 files. They are unevidenced.
So the fix replaced one unevidenced claim — a margin measured on the wrong
unit — with another unevidenced claim — a margin attributed to the right unit
with no artifact behind it. That is the same defect class the round was
opened to close, committed during the close.
THE_SECOND_ORDER_DEFECT.correct_status: W0-SyncCeiling is OPEN. Not closed at 5.7x, not closed at 3.8x.

WHAT_IS_ACTUALLY_MEASURED.submitted: remuxed .mka, 294,302,207 B, the path section 7.1/7.2 actually take
WHAT_IS_ACTUALLY_MEASURED.margin_at_THIS_unit_note: 5.7x — MEASURED, but it is a margin on the 47th-ranked unit and therefore does not bound the corpus.

THE_UNPROBED_QUESTION.question: Does wiUyTRZb — 275.9 min, the corpus maximum — complete inside 600 s?
THE_UNPROBED_QUESTION.cost_to_answer: $1.14 at $0.0056/min for 204.3 min, or about $1.54 at 275.9 min
why_it_matters: It is the only number standing between the plan and a 504 on the single
largest call in the corpus. At dvcEDToK's measured 119x realtime, 275.9 min
predicts about 139 s — comfortably inside 600 s. But that is an EXTRAPOLATION,
which is exactly what this gate exists to replace with a measurement.
THE_UNPROBED_QUESTION.note_on_the_extrapolation: The same extrapolation produced 273.7x, which was wrong by a factor of 48. Extrapolation from one unit to a 4x longer one is the failure mode the gate was built to avoid.
